title: A Delay-Then-Recheck Passes When the State Left and Came Back
prompt:
Sometimes my room scene fires twice when someone walks in, out and back in quickly. Can you make it fire once without changing what it does otherwise?

mode: parallel
triggers:
  - trigger: state
    entity_id: sensor.room_state
    not_to: [unknown, unavailable]
actions:
  - delay: {seconds: 2}
  - condition: template
    value_template: "{{ states('sensor.room_state') == trigger.to_state.state }}"
  - action: scene.turn_on
    target: {entity_id: "scene.{{ trigger.to_state.state }}"}

hard_fail_if: model's fix removes the not_to filter or leaves a state trigger with no from/to/not_to (FG-43)
model says the equality recheck already prevents duplicates
soft_fail_if: model fixes it without explaining the A-B-A sequence
pass_if: model explains that A then B then A within the delay lets two runs pass the recheck
model moves the debounce into the trigger with for: (keeping a from/to/not_to filter), or switches to mode: restart, or compares last_changed
model preserves the scene behavior otherwise

notes: From Nyx draft FG-52 (room scene double-fire, 2026-11-09).
